statement_blocker: The catalog does not select a design class, point and block representation, parameters, admissibility or divisibility hypotheses, multiplicity convention, exact or asymptotic regime, ordered binders, conclusion, or boundary cases. Choosing a BIBD, t-design, Steiner-system, Wilson, asymptotic, resolvable, or Latin-square result would invent or substitute proposition-changing mathematics and may absorb neighboring targets.
target_decision: redirect the catalog family label to a corrected, independently reviewed, source-selected exact proposition before ordinary statement or proof execution
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix the point carrier and universe, finite-set or finite-type encoding, block-family carrier and multiplicity representation, design parameters, equality and isomorphism conventions, and all typeclass data.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not choose one construction, exact existence theorem, sufficiently-large-parameter theorem, admissibility equivalence, classification, enumeration, or asymptotic result.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; the statement phase must resolve every empty, zero, singleton, trivial-block, multiplicity, vacuity, and parameter-order case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: existence of a t-(v,k,lambda) design under a source-selected exact set of admissibility and size conditions
existence of a balanced incomplete block design or pairwise balanced design with fixed parameters
existence of Steiner systems, including Steiner triple systems as a special family
Wilson-style exact or asymptotic existence for t-designs, pairwise balanced designs, or another selected class
existence of resolvable, group-divisible, covering, packing, Latin-square, or other specialized designs
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: t = 0, lambda = 0, k = 0, v = 0, and singleton point carriers
t > k, k > v, t = k, k = v, and parameter tuples with no admissible designs
empty block families, empty blocks, full blocks, and vacuous incidence predicates
repeated identical blocks and whether multiplicity contributes to incidence counts
simple versus nonsimple designs and equality versus isomorphism when designs are counted
finite exceptional parameter sets and the exact threshold in any asymptotic existence result
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-0898 Kirkman schoolgirl or Steiner triple-system existence
THM-M-0899 Wilson's named t-design existence target
THM-M-0900 the catalog's named asymptotic design-existence target
a single explicit finite design presented as a universal existence theorem
necessary counting or divisibility conditions presented as sufficient existence
a structure, predicate field, or hypothesis that assumes the desired design exists
generic Finset, powerset, set-family, cardinality, hypergraph, or incidence APIs alone
a randomized search, SAT result, database lookup, numerical experiment, or unchecked certificate
